blockingLoop.evidence: Identical message twice: 'covers washing machines, washer-dryers, tumble dryers, dishwashers, fridges and freezers, ovens and cookers, hobs, microwaves and vacuum cleaners, so I can't diagnose that one.'

rationale: The assistant refused an in-scope robot vacuum query while its own scope statement explicitly lists vacuum cleaners, then repeated the identical refusal verbatim after the customer pointed out the contradiction and restated the model and error code. It ignored every piece of customer evidence (Roomba i7, Error 2, brush message, long-haired dog) and gave none of the simple, safe guidance the case required (clean the rubber brushes and under the end caps). Nothing unsafe or fabricated was said and no parts were pushed, but the conversation delivered zero value and was a blocking loop.
